description: This file defines utility functions for splitting a string into tokens and adding valid tokens to a custom LinkedList structure.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A Kotlin object containing static utility methods for splitting strings into tokens.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns a LinkedList of tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid (non-empty).
